summary: Quote on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX, scrip 999920000, Exch N, ExchType C): ltp, OHLC, ChgPcnt and the trade time.

notes: Frame worked here in 5paisa's MarketFeedV3 shape for an index (no traded quantity, no book: zeros), as the master names indices (scrip codes above 999900 on N/C and B/C).

deviations.reason: The desktop's renderer gives an index price_change and price_change_percent (ltp less the previous close, and 5paisa's ChgPcnt), as the recorded Zerodha index frame carries them; the 5paisa web adapter sends ChgPcnt as percent_change only, which the desktop sends too. Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch (5paisa: neither key on an index).
